title: Collision Repair Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Collision Repair: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Collision Repair Estimate Worksheet covers damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need. The collision repair coordinator records Collision Repair observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Collision Repair Estimate Worksheet keeps Collision Repair exceptions visible until the collision repair coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Collision Repair Estimate Worksheet at intake area, body bay, frame or measurement area, refinish area, and delivery point. Document damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need identity before Collision Repair begins. Compare damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need findings with stated Collision Repair criteria; route unresolved Collision Repair issues to qualified collision and structural repair reviewer. For Collision Repair Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Collision Repair. Ask qualified collision and structural repair reviewer to review Collision Repair conditions beyond the collision repair coordinator's role.

sections.title: Vehicle, customer, and estimate identity
sections.guidance: Identify the customer, asset or property, estimator, and basis date before pricing the work.

blocks.guidance: Use the Collision Repair identifier printed on damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need or its linked source record.

sections.title: Vehicle findings and pricing evidence
sections.guidance: Price the observable work and options. Keep concealed conditions and unconfirmed quantities out of fixed scope.

blocks.label: Collision Repair scope observations
items: Body, structural, suspension, restraint, and glass concern
Part type, fit, corrosion protection, and refinish process
Scan, calibration, alignment, and system verification
Quality, appearance, function, and final safety review
blocks.guidance: Mark what was observed or supplied as estimate input; explain anything material that could not be inspected.

sections.title: Estimate exception and change conditions
sections.guidance: State what could change the price, timing, method, or scope before the customer or responsible party decides.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when structural, restraint, repair-method, calibration, alignment, or final safety verification remains unresolved. Protect damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need; document the Collision Repair notification and await qualified collision and structural repair reviewer direction.

blocks.label: Conditions that may require a revised estimate or specialist review
blocks.guidance: For Collision Repair, identify affected damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need scope; ask collision repair coordinator to document the Collision Repair immediate control before continuing.

sections.title: Estimate decision and selected repair scope
sections.guidance: Record the selected option and spending limit. Approval of an estimate authorizes only the stated scope and terms.
